scope: Three clean Halloween aquarium background panoramas

files.name: 호박등 아래 작은 찻집
files.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: final full-bleed painted background panorama for a cozy aquarium game. ONE continuous landscape, approximately 27:16, high resolution. This will span three adjacent portrait phone views, not a triptych or collage.
Style: refined softly painted fantasy illustration, delicate natural edges, gentle dimensional shading and beautiful materials, consistent with a premium enchanted underwater garden. Cute and elegant Halloween, calm and uncluttered.
Composition: coherent underwater space, rippling overhead water, soft caustics and layered depth. Architecture and decorative accents concentrated at left and right edges and low floor. Keep the middle 45 percent and most middle swimming height very open so colorful fish added by the game remain visible. Connect all three thirds naturally; no panels or seams.
Constraints: background scenery only. No fish, animals, live ghosts, witches, people or fairy characters. Ghost-shaped inanimate lamps are allowed when specified. No text, letters, prices, signs, UI, aquarium glass frame, border or watermark. No horror, skulls, blood, dense cobwebs, heavy fog, overwhelming glitter or extreme bloom. Just a few tasteful Halloween motifs. Render ONE finished image.

Theme: 호박등 아래 작은 찻집 — Little Teahouse beneath Pumpkin Lanterns.
A tiny submerged cream-and-apricot teahouse tucked into the far left stone terrace, rounded arched windows with warm honey light, a little curved counter and one tiny porcelain tea set. At the far right a low stone seat with a few small glowing carved pumpkin lanterns and gentle autumn vines. The pumpkins have friendly simple sleepy faces, not frightening expressions. A few pale autumn leaves settle near a soft sand floor. Warm muted pumpkin orange and cream scenery contrasted against broad clear pale turquoise water. Restrained, airy, luxurious, welcoming. No large central house, no dense pumpkin patch, no huge props or piles of dishes.

Theme: 달빛에 잠든 유령 온실 — Ghost Conservatory Asleep in Moonlight.
An airy enchanted submerged mint-glass conservatory in pale sage, mint, ivory and silver. Delicate curved greenhouse frames grow from the outer side terraces, small white bellflowers and a few silver vines frame the margins. Two or three small hanging white ghost-shaped paper lanterns with tiny sleepy eyes decorate the sides only; clearly ornamental lamps, not live creatures. Gentle silver moonlight filters through rippling water overhead. Clear misty mint-blue middle water and pale smooth stone/sand floor remain spacious and readable. Peaceful and clean, no crowded plants or strong haze, no giant structure across the middle, no frightening faces.

Theme: 마녀가 비운 보랏빛 방 — The Witch's Quiet Lavender Room.
A serene magical submerged room with soft lavender stone walls, muted lilac, dusty periwinkle and warm ivory. The far left has a small curved wooden shelf containing only four or five elegant colored potion bottles and a closed old book; a tiny witch hat rests on the ledge. The far right has a slim crescent-shaped arched window, a low ivory cabinet and one softly glowing candle-lantern. A single delicate cobweb is tucked into an extreme upper corner. Leave a wide uncluttered lavender-blue central swimming space and connected clean pale floor, with watery surface refraction and gentle caustics establishing that this is an underwater fantasy aquarium. Cozy, refined and softly luminous; no witch, no characters, no big cauldron in the middle, no dense bookshelf, no rows of clutter.
